title: Blue Moon Dolphin Cruise

services.name: Choose your Cruise
services.desc: The Blue Moon, based in Marina Del Rey, is a quick drive for anyone living in or visiting the Los Angeles area. We offer Private Cruises for groups of up to 6 and up to 12 people. This includes a captain and crew ready to take you anywhere you want to explore in Santa Monica Bay. We have been taking dolphin cruises off the coast of Los Angeles, out of Marina Del Rey, for 20 years. The Blue Moon Private Boat tour offers you an outdoor adventure with friends, family or coworkers. You can bring music, food and beverages of your choice.
